hypothesis: Can the exact unrestricted counterexample CNF be reduced from quadratic tableau cost to near-linear stage-budget size without copying all input and output cells for each program?
topology: Sparse time-order and memory-order records, shared authenticated table lookups, exact simultaneous rejection certificates.
adversarial: Memory keys must include program identity and time.
All initial symbol claims and selected-clause lookups must be authenticated.
Timeout, halt, malformed and falsified output cases must be exhaustive and mutually safe.
CNF extension need not be unique; finite canonical tests alone do not prove soundness.
scope: Identical U and exact stage clocks on the original explicit selector; existential trace and rejection certificate CNF for arbitrary n,s.
cost: O((L+2^s) poly(s+log(L+2))) ordinary explicit CNF bits; uniform polynomial constructor in L+2^s; no claim of quasilinear one-tape construction or SAT search.

planner.question: Can the exact unrestricted counterexample CNF be reduced from quadratic tableau cost to near-linear stage-budget size without copying all input and output cells for each program?
planner.strategy: Sparse time records, memory-order sorting, shared input and clause lookups, constant terminal reads to certify actual rejection.
planner.alternative: Audit same-clock self-reference and encoding expansion rather than infer SAT of the compact formula.
planner.stop_rule: Do not claim a new exponent or a satisfying model from encoding size alone.
literature_leads: Van Melkebeek survey, near-linear Cook reductions using sorting networks; From RAM to SAT; prior exact symbolic H compiler. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: An explicit width-three J_(n,s) encodes the exact previous H predicate with O((L+2^s) poly(s+log(L+2))) bit size.
construct.scope: Identical U and exact stage clocks on the original explicit selector; existential trace and rejection certificate CNF for arbitrary n,s.
construct.derivation: Compute transitions from guessed reads, sort memory records by program/address/time, authenticate initial data and chosen violated clauses by shared table lookups, and certify failure with timeout, blank or false selected clause.
unresolved_steps: Prove actual J satisfiability at unbounded cubic lengths or a uniform success cutoff.
candidate_tests: Actual batched trace circuits versus original interpreter, exact CNF extension, sort and corruption controls, full small-stage wrapper.

alternative.claim: The compact compiler does not create a same-length diagonal contradiction or establish an efficient SAT search procedure.
alternative.scope: Identical U and exact stage clocks on the original explicit selector; existential trace and rejection certificate CNF for arbitrary n,s.
alternative.derivation: The ordinary CNF is a different formula, potentially larger; its complete selector representation and clock change. No existence of a model is implied.
unresolved_steps: Resource-preserving adversarial existence, not just compilation.
candidate_tests: Active exhaustive fallback and successful-output rejection-certificate controls.

objections: Memory keys must include program identity and time.
All initial symbol claims and selected-clause lookups must be authenticated.
Timeout, halt, malformed and falsified output cases must be exhaustive and mutually safe.
CNF extension need not be unique; finite canonical tests alone do not prove soundness.
counterexample_candidates: A forged initial symbol or unselected clause would yield a false failure without lookup constraints.
Feeding the compiled CNF back to U changes the input length and clock.
critic.equivalence_audit: Same U descriptions, exact per-program clocks, absorbing halt, authentic sparse memory semantics, original verifier and built-ins.
critic.barrier_audit: No cubic or all-exponent existence theorem; no P versus NP resolution.

cost.computational_model: Same original tape interpreter and verified witness scheduler; bounded-fan-in Boolean circuit and explicit width-three CNF.

cost_ledger.encoding: Original selector/witness and sparse records of logarithmic-width addresses, times and metadata
cost_ledger.preprocessing: Generate actual transition tables and one shared original input and clause table
cost_ledger.inference: Local transitions, deterministic sorting networks, authenticated lookup, constant-sized rejection certificate per program
cost_ledger.repetitions: At most (s+1)2^s scheduled transitions and O(2^s) terminal records
cost_ledger.arithmetic_bits: Charge record widths, comparison and addition circuits, wire-index bits
cost_ledger.memory: Explicit network and trace variables; polynomial constructor storage, no per-program full input copies in formula
cost_ledger.reconstruction: Read p,x from model; trace uniquely determined, rejection reason may vary
cost_ledger.overall: O((L+2^s) poly(s+log(L+2))) ordinary explicit CNF bits; uniform polynomial constructor in L+2^s; no claim of quasilinear one-tape construction or SAT search.
